articulation.label: window
articulation.alt: window: /w/ → /ɪ/ → /n/ → /d/ → /oʊ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /w/: Round the lips; raise the back of the tongue.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
